assumptions: Phase 0 is a required blocker before later event-intelligence work.
No production or staging migrations were applied during discovery.
No Stripe live-mode mutation was performed; billing go-live remains gated by APPROVED_BILLING_LIVE.
CQC API access is treated as optional enrichment because FEATURE_CQC_API is unset and the MLP must run bulk-first.

stack.migrationTooling: db/apply_migrations.py applies db/migrations/[0-9][0-9][0-9]_*.sql and records schema_migrations
deploymentTargets: Vercel-compatible Next.js frontend per README and CI

currentMechanism: extract_cqc.py, clean_cqc.py, quality_audit.py, prepare_directory.py, and run_enriched_pipeline.sh form the CQC ETL path.
incremental_update.py performs API/list scanning and writes care_providers, rating_changes, and pipeline_runs.
api/services/new_registration_feed.py projects care_providers registrations into trusted_event_ledger.
tools/run_new_registration_feed_cycle.py syncs feed events, delivers webhooks, queues digests, and closes pipeline_runs.
ingestion.currentReadModel: care_providers is the live provider/location table; care_providers.id stores the CQC location id.
ingestion.knownGap: rating_changes is empty, so rating-movement pulse is not active despite new-registration events existing.

tenantModel.assessment: No global tenant_id on user, subscription, provider, event, or feed tables. Multi-tenancy is primarily account/user scoped.

auth.publicApiAuth: X-API-Key with api_keys table, tier limits, key_hash/key_prefix support, and API_MASTER_KEY rotation.
auth.userAuth: Email/password sessions via users and user_sessions.

stripe.secretKeyMode: live-configured in local .env; do not mutate without APPROVED_BILLING_LIVE
stripe.webhookVerification: api/routers/billing.py verifies Stripe webhook signatures and stripe_processed_events deduplicates events.

blockersAndGates: G1: Applying event-intelligence migrations to staging/production requires APPROVED_MIGRATION.
G2: Stripe live productisation requires APPROVED_BILLING_LIVE.
The full MLP requires at least two dated CQC extracts or a fixture-backed diff engine; live historical backfill is not proven by Phase 0.
